policy: A current-review epoch admits genuinely new executable surfaces into the reviewed executable ownership state under a present-day review identity, extending the exact amendment chain tail it pins without rewriting the dated historical review or any amendment. It may only add paths no earlier authority assigned, only into a reviewed exact inventory whose membership movement it declares and accounts for path for path, and it can never carry a source-hash rebind: a fingerprint movement is never the act that creates ownership.
